posts.title: A Spending Guardrail for Agentic Payments — Hands-On x402
posts.description: Let Claude pay an x402 testnet paywall without holding the wallet key, then test payment limits, rolling budgets, and duplicate protection.

posts.title: Your Coding Agent Will Always Tell You It’s Safe
posts.description: Agentic security starts from agent trust, and trust starts from verifiability: an agent can't monitor itself or declare itself secure. Why defense in depth needs a watcher underneath — read-only, open source, local-only — and why I built perch.
